description: Unsaved changes: nothing is closed, and the next step is to save first (the project has no file yet).

error.detail: the project has unsaved changes; discardUnsaved true quits anyway and loses them

nextStep.message: The project was never saved, so it has no file: save it with opentune_save_project (mode save_as, an absolute .otproj path, for example next to the vocal file), then call opentune_quit again. Or ask the user whether the unsaved changes may be thrown away; only if the user explicitly agrees, call opentune_quit again with discard_unsaved: true.
